arxiv-2202-01575.title: CoST: Contrastive Learning of Disentangled Seasonal-Trend Representations for Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2202-01575.creator: Gerald Woo, Chenghao Liu, Doyen Sahoo, Akshat Kumar & Steven Hoi
arxiv-2202-01575.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gerald Woo, Chenghao Liu, Doyen Sahoo, Akshat Kumar & Steven Hoi. Deep learning has been actively studied for time series forecasting, and the mainstream paradigm is based on the end-to-end training of neural network architectures, ranging from classical LSTM/RNNs to more recent TCNs and Transformers.

arxiv-2311-13124.title: Height of walks with resets, the Moran model, and the discrete Gumbel distribution
arxiv-2311-13124.creator: Rafik Aguech 1 \orcid 0000-0002-4483-9356, Asma Althagafi 2 \orcid 0000-0001-5499-0810, Cyril Banderier 3 \orcid 0000-0003-0755-3022
arxiv-2311-13124.description: Abstract . In this article, we consider several models of random walks in one or several dimensions, additionally allowing, at any unit of time, a reset (or “catastrophe”) of the walk with probability q q . We establish the distribution of the final altitude.

arxiv-2408-14111.title: Bengali Sign Language Recognition through Hand Pose Estimation using Multi-Branch Spatial-Temporal Attention Model Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2408-14111.creator: Abu Saleh Musa Miah, Md. Al Mehedi Hasan, Md Hadiuzzaman, Muhammad Nazrul Islam, Jungpil Shin
arxiv-2408-14111.description: Abstract Hand gesture-based sign language recognition (SLR) is one of the most advanced applications of machine learning, and computer vision uses hand gestures. However, many standard automatic recognition systems have been developed for other languages such as English, Turkish, Arabic, British etc. However, there still are some challenges to achieving standard Bangla sign language (BSL) recognition systems.

arxiv-2410-19119.title: Tera-Scale Multilevel Graph Partitioning
arxiv-2410-19119.creator: Daniel Salwasser, Daniel Seemaier, Lars Gottesbüren, Peter Sanders
arxiv-2410-19119.description: Abstract We present TeraPart, a memory-efficient multilevel graph partitioning method that is designed to scale to extremely large graphs. In balanced graph partitioning, the goal is to divide the vertices into k k blocks with balanced size while cutting as few edges as possible.

arxiv-2501-09481.title: MonoSOWA: Scalable monocular 3D Object detector Without human Annotations
arxiv-2501-09481.creator: Jan Skvrna, Lukas Neumann
arxiv-2501-09481.description: Abstract Inferring object 3D position and orientation from a single RGB camera is a foundational task in computer vision with many important applications. Traditionally, 3D object detection methods are trained in a fully-supervised setup, requiring LiDAR and vast amounts of human annotations, which are laborious, costly, and do not scale well with the ever-increasing amounts of data being captured.

arxiv-2504-19647.title: Resonances and computations
arxiv-2504-19647.creator: Yvain Bruned, Frédéric Rousset, Katharina Schratz
arxiv-2504-19647.description: Abstract The computation of time dynamics arising in nonlinear time-dependent partial differential equations is an ongoing challenge in numerical analysis, especially once roughness comes into play. Classical numerical schemes in general fail to resolve the oscillatory behaviour in the solution which leads to numerical instabilities and loss of convergence. Dispersive equations, e.g.

arxiv-2506-00926.title: Simple holograpic dual of the Maxwell-Cattaneo model
arxiv-2506-00926.creator: Yongjun Ahn 1,2, Matteo Baggioli 1,2, Yanyan Bu 3, Masataka Matsumoto 4,1, Xiyang Sun 3
arxiv-2506-00926.description: Abstract Diffusion, as described by Fick’s laws, governs the spreading of particles, information, data, and even financial fluctuations. However, due to its parabolic structure, the diffusion equation leads to an unphysical prediction: any localized disturbance instantaneously affects the entire system.

arxiv-2507-11356.title: What is the Best Process Model Representation? A Comparative Analysis for Process Modeling with Large Language Models
arxiv-2507-11356.creator: Alexis Brissard, Frédéric Cuppens, Amal Zouaq
arxiv-2507-11356.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied for Process Modeling (PMo) tasks such as Process Model Generation (PMG). To support these tasks, researchers have introduced a variety of Process Model Representations (PMRs) that serve as model abstractions or generation targets. However, these PMRs differ widely in structure, complexity, and usability, and have never been systematically compared.

arxiv-2507-19042.title: Arcsecond-Scale X-ray Imaging and Spectroscopy of SS 433 with Chandra HETG
arxiv-2507-19042.creator: Yusuke Sakai, \altemailmark \orcid 0000-0002-5809-3516 Shinya Yamada, \orcid 0000-0003-4808-893X Haruka Sakemi, \orcid 0000-0002-4037-1346 Mami Machida, \orcid 0000-0001-6353-7639 Taichi Igarashi, \orcid 0000-0003-4369-7314 Ryota Hayakawa, \orcid 0000-0002-3752-0048 Miho Tan, \orcid 0009-0000-2006-2
arxiv-2507-19042.description: Abstract We present a spatial and spectral analysis of arcsecond-scale X-ray emission in SS433 using zeroth-order data from Chandra High-Energy Transmission Grating (HETG) observations. The analysis is based on 24 observations acquired between 1999 and 2024, comprising a total exposure of ∼ \sim 850 ks and covering a wide range of orbital and precessional phases.

arxiv-2508-02809.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Manuel D. Contreras †, Santiago Díaz-Madrigal †, Pavel Gumenyuk ‡. arxiv-2512-13521.title: Optically trapped Feshbach molecules of fermionic 161 Dy and 40 K: Role of light-induced and collisional losses
arxiv-2512-13521.creator: Alberto Canali, Chun-Kit Wong, Luc Absil, Zhu-Xiong Ye, Marian Kreyer, Emil Kirilov, Rudolf Grimm
arxiv-2512-13521.description: Abstract We study the decay of a dense, ultracold sample of weakly bound DyK dimers stored in an optical dipole trap. Our bosonic dimers are composed of the fermionic isotopes 161 Dy and 40 K, which is of particular interest for experiments related to pairing and superfluidity in fermionic systems with mass imbalance.

pmc-10526315.title: Vaping, Environmental Toxicants Exposure, and Lung Cancer Risk
pmc-10526315.creator: Shaimaa A Shehata, Eman A Toraih, Ezzat A Ismail, Abeer M Hagras, Ekramy Elmorsy, Manal S Fawzy, Abhijit Chakraborty, Faisal Aziz, Sandro Arguelles
pmc-10526315.description: Simple SummaryLung cancer (LC) is considered one of the most common cancers globally. Numerous studies have determined the relations between E-cigarette, or vaping, products (EVPs) and many proven environmental toxicants in LC development. Even though tobacco smoke remains the chief cause of LC, there is increasing concern that EVPs use could also increase LC risk.

pmc-10687337.title: Blue light impairs cornea and corneal wound healing by downregulating VCAM1 partly
pmc-10687337.creator: Kuangqi Chen, Le Jin, Yingying Wen, Qianjie Yang, Xiang Li, Liyue Zhang, Liyin Wang, Yutong Xia, Zhitong Chen, Chen Xie, Jianping Tong, Ye Shen
pmc-10687337.description: SummaryThis study aimed to investigate the effects of long-term pollution from different wavelengths of light on the corneal epithelium (CE) and identify potential biomarkers. Rabbits were exposed to red, green, blue, white, and environmental light for 6 weeks. The CE was assessed using various techniques such as fluorescein sodium staining, transcriptome sequencing, electron microscopy, and molecular assays.

pmc-10753883.title: Characterization of Water Structure and Phase Behavior within Metal–Organic Nanotubes
pmc-10753883.creator: Tiron
pmc-10753883.description: Water behavior under nanoconfinement varies significantly from that in the bulk but also depends on the nature of the pore walls. Hybrid compound offers the ideal system to explore water behavior in complex materials, so a model metal–organic nanotube (UMONT) material was utilized to explore the behavior of water between 100 and 293 K.

pmc-11648683.title: The association between fibroblast growth factor 21 with diabetes retinopathy among type 2 diabetes mellitus patients: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and meta-regression
pmc-11648683.creator: Herni Basir, Annisa Salsabilla Dwi Nugrahani, Andi Makbul Aman, Syakib Bakri, Haerani Rasyid, Husaini Umar, Faridin H. P., Andi Muhammad Ichsan, Andi Alfian Zainuddin
pmc-11648683.description: BackgroundDiabetic retinopathy (DR), a leading cause of vision loss worldwide, is a common complication of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) driven by chronic hyperglycemia and microvascular damage. Fibroblast growth factor 21 (FGF21) is crucial in blood sugar regulation and has been linked to DR incidence and severity.

pmc-11674514.title: Interleukin-6 Modulation in Ovarian Cancer Necessitates a Targeted Strategy: From the Approved to Emerging Therapies
pmc-11674514.creator: Hina Amer, Nirmala C. Kampan, Catherine Itsiopoulos, Katie L. Flanagan, Clare L. Scott, Apriliana E. R. Kartikasari, Magdalena Plebanski
pmc-11674514.description: Simple SummaryIn this article, we review the role of Interleukin-6 in every stage of ovarian cancer development, highlight the approved and emerging therapies to target Interleukin-6 and its signaling in cancer, and identify their combination with other therapies to provide a more effective and personalized treatment for ovarian cancer. 1.

pmc-11713693.title: A Systematic Review of Interventions Targeting Social Isolation Among Middle‐Aged Adults
pmc-11713693.creator: Jiwon Shin, Hyun Yang, Sohyeon Yun, Inhye Kim, Hyunseo An, Hae Yean Park
pmc-11713693.description: BackgroundThis systematic review aims to examine recent interventions targeting social isolation among middle‐aged adults, identifying trends in intervention types and their effectiveness. It highlights the urgent need for establishing a foundation for social isolation research across all ages.MethodA comprehensive literature search was conducted using PubMed, EMBASE, and CINAHL databases from January 1, 2014, to January 1, 2024.

pmc-12683050.title: Assessment of the stentless mitral valve and operation using bioengineering method
pmc-12683050.creator: Junpei Takada, Hitoshi Kasegawa, Kiyotaka Iwasaki
pmc-12683050.description: ObjectiveWe report the results of assessment of the Normo valve and the Normo operation using bioengineering methods.MethodsThe Normo valve, made from bovine pericardium using a specially designed template and the flexible ring (27-mm Duran; Medtronic Inc), was installed into the pulsatile circulatory simulator. A 27-mm bioprosthetic valve (Mosaic; Medtronic Inc) was used as a control.

pmc-13472530.title: Digital Markers for Passive Remote Monitoring of Bipolar Disorder: Systematic Review
pmc-13472530.creator: Thomas P Kutcher, Isha Chakraborty, Kristin Kostick-Quenet, Akane Sano, Nidal Moukaddam, Jeffrey A Herron, Wayne K Goodman, Sameer A Sheth, Ashutosh Sabharwal, Nicole R Provenza, John Torous
pmc-13472530.description: BackgroundBipolar disorder (BD) features episodic shifts among mania, hypomania, depression, mixed states, and euthymia. Timely detection of mood transitions is difficult due to infrequent clinical touchpoints. Digital health technologies, including wearables and smartphones, offer a unique opportunity to passively and continuously monitor behavior and physiology that could reflect underlying mood dynamics in real-world settings.

pmc-13624355.title: Understanding young adults’ sun safety practices in the workplace
pmc-13624355.creator: Emma K Quinn, Ela Rydz, Anita Brobbey, Robert T Duffy, Sajjad S Fazel, Cheryl E Peters
pmc-13624355.description: BackgroundCurrent literature suggests young outdoor workers experience a higher risk for workplace exposures including elevated risk of sun related health risks for outdoor workers.ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess young workers’ understanding of sun-related hazards and associated sun safety practices in the workplace.
